title: feat(prompt): capture margin distances stated as tumor location
body:
Distal/proximal margin clearance is often reported as the tumor location in the gross description ('tumor located X cm from the distal resection line'), not a labelled margin field — weaker models missed these. Adds an instruction to capture tumor-location-derived margin distances (and ignore polyp-to-margin distances). Validated: recovered 5/6 previously-missed distal margins on gemma4:31b. 84 tests pass.
